app_type: POS Dashboard / Cash Tracking Single-Page App

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Use IBM Plex Sans for robust, professional readability.
rules.numbers_and_data: MANDATORY: All currency, balances, receipt previews, transaction amounts, and reports MUST use JetBrains Mono (font-mono) with tabular-nums.

colors.background: Deep Navy/Charcoal (#0B1120) - avoids harsh pure black while reducing glare.
colors.surface: Elevated Navy (#111827) with subtle 1px inner borders (#1F2937).
colors.primary: Warning Amber (#F59E0B) - used for primary actions, drawer testing, and active statuses.

functional.payment_in: Mint Green (#10B981) - for positive cash flow and top-ups.

rules: CRITICAL: No generic purple gradients. No soft shadows. Use 1px solid borders to define surfaces.
High contrast is mandatory for retail lighting.
Use transparency (e.g., bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500) for IN/OUT transaction badges rather than flat colors.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

layouts.strategy: The High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards)
layouts.structure: Fixed Top Navigation bar + Split screen dashboard. Left side (40%): Transaction Log & Live Feed. Right side (60%): Massive Live Balance, Quick Actions, and Denomination Grid.
layouts.spacing: Dense but clear. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. gap-4 for grids. Elements must feel physically close to minimize mouse/eye travel.
layouts.borders: Grid Borders Look: Expose the skeleton. Use solid 1px borders (border-border) to define functional areas.
layouts.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism on data cards to prevent visual refraction. Maximum border radius: 8px (rounded-md).

top_bar.description: Solid background (bg-[#111827]) with a hard bottom border. Contains SELTRACK logo and the Staff Dropdown.
top_bar.staff_dropdown: Simple Shadcn Select component customized for high contrast. No password. Just predefined staff names. Use large click targets for touch/fast usage.

live_balance_card.description: The hero component. A massive, undeniable truth of the current cash drawer state.
live_balance_card.style: JetBrains Mono. Stark white text. 1px border. Do not center; align left or top-right depending on the grid cell. Format: ₹ XX,XXX.XX

transaction_rows.description: Chronological feed of IN, OUT, and Adjustments.
transaction_rows.style: CSS Grid for perfect column alignment. Date/Time (muted, small), User (truncate), Type (Badge), Amount (JetBrains Mono, aligned right). Hover state: background slightly lighter (hover:bg-white/5) with explicit text color.

denomination_counter.description: Grid of inputs for Shift Open/Close and Adjustments for INR notes (500, 200, 100, 50, 20, 10, coins).
denomination_counter.style: Bento 2-column grid. Left: Note label (e.g., ₹500). Right: Input field. Must auto-calculate total in real-time with mono font.

drawer_status_indicator.description: Visual indicator of the physical cash drawer state.
drawer_status_indicator.style: Small badge near the top or balance. 'CLOSED' is dim/gray. 'OPEN' is bright amber with a pulsing animation (animate-pulse on a dot).

receipt_preview.description: Preview of the ESC/POS thermal printout.
receipt_preview.style: MANDATORY: Paper-white background (#FFFFFF), ink-black text (#000000). 100% JetBrains Mono. Uppercase text. Dashed top/bottom borders to mimic receipt cuts. This MUST look like a literal receipt, providing intentional harsh contrast to the dark app theme.

settings_modal.description: Modal for Web Serial / WebUSB printer & drawer device pairing.
settings_modal.style: Technical styling. Use monospace fonts for device addresses. Include a highly visible 'Test Drawer' button (Amber) that pulses on click.

reports_view.style: Dense tabular layout. Show expected vs actual variance in red/green. Provide clear CSV/PDF export buttons.

motion.philosophy: Instant and functional. Retail workers need speed, not long animations.
rules: Drawer Open pulse: use standard Tailwind animate-pulse for the status dot.
Number counting: Do NOT animate the live balance counting up/down. Instant, deterministic updates are required for POS accuracy.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone weight for actions, or Bold weights for high visibility in buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle noise on the dark background to reduce screen glare and make the interface feel tactile like a physical register.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Ensure amber/green/red text on dark backgrounds uses lighter shades (e.g., 400 or 500 scale) to remain readable.
accessibility.keyboard: MANDATORY: Complete keyboard navigation. Forms, inputs, and Shift Close modals must be fully navigable via Tab and Enter keys for fast POS entry.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='staff-dropdown', data-testid='payment-in-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge date-fns
Configure Tailwind: Setup the dark navy and amber palette in tailwind.config.js mapping primary to Amber 500, background to Deep Navy (#0B1120), surface to Elevated Navy (#111827).
Fonts: Import IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.css.
Build standard Shadcn components in src/components/ui: Button, Select, Dialog, Card, Badge, Input, Table. Ensure these are JS files, not TSX.
Structure the layout: Create a TopNav and a main Dashboard Layout using CSS Grid to map to the 40/60 split.
Implement the Denomination logic state: controlled inputs mapping to 500, 200, 100, 50, 20, 10, coins and calculating a sum.
Create the Receipt Preview component with stark white background and black mono text to emulate thermal printing.
Ensure the drawer connection functions map to Web Serial / WebUSB API correctly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
